products.title: Orr M81 Laus Ring
products.body_html:
The M81 ring covers both sides of the hand. – just like a glove.

The ring is set with a bunch of light-pink, bright-pink and hot-pink rubies on one side and white zirconia stones on the other. The stones roll around and rotate freely inside their settings and form a kind of a symphony when worn on a hand.

The M81 weighs about half a kilogram and is certainly not the most practical ring but it is an unique piece of an art object that could never not have fun.

products.title: Saga Sandcast Rings
products.body_html:
Engagement rings that are made in 14k gold the way our ancestors did. They are cast into a sand mold that is made specially for each pair of rings. The gold is melted in one crucible and poured into the sand mold and when the mold brakes the rings are still connected together.
The texture of the rings comes from the sand mold and is therefore never the same, they are polished on the inside.
